system.description:
Originating among the warrior caste as a means of reinforcing bronze and iron weapons for prolonged combat, this power imparts a measure of the Assamite's own resilience into an item by coating it with her blood. Viziers use it to preserve treasured relics.

The player spends a Willpower Trait, and the character coats the item with her vitae: one Blood Trait per foot of length for a weapon (an average sword needs three, a lance up to 15), or one Blood Trait per extra soak Trait desired for armor. A tempered weapon deals one additional bonus Trait of damage and becomes unbreakable short of a supernatural power greater than the character's Fortitude rating or catastrophic mundane trauma; tempered armor grants one extra soak Trait and the same resilience. This power cannot reinforce flexible items (whips, leather, silk). Costs 15 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait per foot of weapon length, or per extra soak Trait for armor
system.prerequisites: Fortitude (any two powers), Quietus (any four powers)
